title: Radiomics feature reliability assessed by intraclass correlation coefficient: a systematic review

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Radiomics feature reliability assessed by intraclass correlation coefficient: a systematic review》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】In these highly heterogeneous studies, feature reliability to image segmentation was much more investigated than reliability to other factors, such as image acquisition, reconstruction, post-processing, and feature quantification.

evidence.text: In these highly heterogeneous studies, feature reliability to image segmentation was much more investigated than reliability to other factors, such as image acquisition, reconstruction, post-processing, and feature quantification.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】To conduct this systematic review, Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines were followed.

evidence.text: To conduct this systematic review, Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines were followed.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Radiomics feature reliability assessed by intraclass correlation coefficient: a systematic review》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Image acquisition was found to introduce much more feature variability than image segmentation, in particular for MRI, based on the reported ICC values.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Image post-processing and feature quantification yielded different levels of radiomics reliability and might be used to mitigate image acquisition-induced variability.

evidence.text: Image acquisition was found to introduce much more feature variability than image segmentation, in particular for MRI, based on the reported ICC values.
Image post-processing and feature quantification yielded different levels of radiomics reliability and might be used to mitigate image acquisition-induced variability.
